sources.title: GeoChat-7B - Models
sources.snippet: GeoChat-7B GeoChat is the first grounded Large Vision Language Model, specifically tailored to Remote Sensing (RS) scenarios. Unlike general-domain models, GeoChat excels in handling high-resolution RS imagery, employing region-level reasoning for comprehensive scene interpretation.

sources.title: Mapping the Future: Discover GeoChat-7B, the Conversational Remote ...
sources.snippet: Remote sensing imagery presents unique challenges—top-down perspectives, tiny objects, and specific geographic contexts. Enter GeoChat-7B, a specialised model hosted on Modelers.cn, the growing hub for Huawei's Ascend AI ecosystem. It is designed to bridge the gap between complex geospatial data and intuitive, natural language interaction.
